remarks:
MORE SPACE THAN MEETS THE EYE! Don't let the two-bedroom designation fool you! This charming Deveaux home offers two bedrooms PLUS an additional versatile room that could serve as a dressing room, home office, den or creative space. It offers CHARACTER, QUALITY & THOUGHTFUL UPDATES! Lovingly cared for by the same owner for more than 27 years, this beautifully maintained 1,356-square-foot home blends timeless character with thoughtful updates and a layout designed for comfortable everyday living. Soaring 9-foot ceilings enhance the sense of space throughout, while beautiful architectural details add warmth and personality. The heart of the home is the impressive custom kitchen, featuring rich mahogany granite countertops, soft-touch cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, pantry, breakfast bar and a custom-built wine bar. The inviting living room offers custom built-ins and a ventless gas fireplace, while the formal dining room provides an elegant setting for everyday meals or entertaining. An updated full bathroom features porcelain tile, a new tub and plumbing, double vanity and modern lighting. Upstairs, two comfortable bedrooms are complemented by a versatile additional room that can easily serve as a home office, study, den, creative space or quiet retreat. The full basement provides additional recreation space, laundry and storage, while a convenient mudroom adds everyday ease. Outside, enjoy a fully fenced backyard with a covered porch, patio and shed, creating a private outdoor space that's easy to enjoy and maintain. Central air and forced-air gas heat provide year-round comfort, with additional updates including a 2024 tankless hot water heater and 2026 dishwasher.
Ideally situated near Whirlpool State Park, Devils Hole, Deveaux Woods Park, scenic walking paths and everyday amenities, this home offers a wonderful combination of character, updates and flexible living space. If you're looking for a home with personality, exceptional kitchen space, 9-foot ceilings, three baths and thoughtful updates throughout, 4017 Washington Street deserves a closer look.
